abstract: Monitors paint stripping and sealant volatile organic compound containment efficiency
system_message:
You are Environmental Safety Officer (ESHC). As the Environmental Safety Officer (ESHC), you monitor paint stripping and sealant volatile organic compound containment efficiency across maintenance facilities, as well as track aerospace alloy recycling performance.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Aerospace alloy recycling（RECYC）
information_points.content:
ESHC-RECYC-FYC：For Changi Heavy Aerostructures Facility, material reclamation records for airframe structural component skin trimmings and scrap reflect a titanium scrap recovery rate of 65 %.
ESHC-RECYC-PE7：For San Antonio Aerospace Overhaul Center, material reclamation records for airframe structural component skin trimmings and scrap show a titanium scrap recovery rate of 85 %.
ESHC-RECYC-DP1：For Shannon Aviation Maintenance Complex, material reclamation records for airframe structural component skin trimmings and scrap indicate a titanium scrap recovery rate of 75 %.

information_points.title: Monitors paint stripping and sealant volatile organic compound containment efficiency（ENVIR）
information_points.content:
ESHC-ENVIR-K6B：Evaluated under a containment measurement basis excluding fugitive hangar bay emissions, the Shannon Aviation Maintenance Complex records a volatile solvent containment efficiency of 88 % in its enclosed widebody paint stripping and repainting ventilation scrubbers.
ESHC-ENVIR-PSX：For the Shannon Aviation Maintenance Complex, the volatile solvent containment efficiency measured across enclosed widebody paint stripping and repainting ventilation scrubbers is 95 %, assessed under a containment measurement basis including fugitive hangar bay emissions.
ESHC-ENVIR-5JS：The San Antonio Aerospace Overhaul Center achieves a volatile solvent containment efficiency of 98 % across its enclosed widebody paint stripping and repainting ventilation scrubbers, evaluated under a containment measurement basis including fugitive hangar bay emissions.
ESHC-ENVIR-0K8：At the Changi Heavy Aerostructures Facility, environmental compliance monitoring of enclosed widebody paint stripping and repainting ventilation scrubbers indicates a volatile solvent containment efficiency of 88 %, calculated with a containment measurement basis including fugitive hangar bay emissions.
